title: Purdue Joins Biomanufacturing Program Designed for Students and Industry Professionals
summary: Through Heartland BioWorks, the regional tech hub established with support from the U.S. Economic Development Administration, the state of Indiana will become the exclusive Midwest provider of NIBRT’s biomanufacturing training programs. Based in Ireland, NIBRT is recognized for its efforts in biomanufacturing education, research, and workforce training.The postPurdue Joins Biomanufacturing Program Designed for Students and Industry Professionalsappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
